name: Arthur Brown
source:
Arthur Brown is the eldest son of the owner of Brown Accounting, a firm famous for serving clients of the upper class. He became acquainted with Alex Wake as Viscount Wake is one of his father’s clients.

Arthur is close with his maternal relatives and particularly with his uncle, whose newspaper business Arthur helped to save from bankruptcy. He enjoys talking with people most of all, but is also known to enjoy fishing at the outskirts of London.

Born in 1861.

[From digital artbook]
